Moltobene is built on the following open-source components. Many thanks to their authors.

string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: Translate recipes: German and English recipes can be translated in the recipe view with “DE | EN”, right on the device and without internet. The original is kept.
To do so, download the language pack German–English once under Settings → Translation (about 172 MB, ideally over Wi-Fi).
Checking off and adjusting servings also work in the translation.

string-array.name: privacy_paragraphs
string-array.item: Recipes, photos and notes are stored only on this device. There is no account, no advertising, no tracking and no sharing with third parties.

The app only goes online on request: for “Import from link” and when downloading the language pack for translation. For “Import from link” it loads exactly that one page and, if available, its photo. As with any browser, the page learns the device’s internet address (IP address), the time and the preferred language. No cookies are stored and no details about the device are sent.
Otherwise content only leaves the device when it is shared or backed up. Notes are never shared. The backup file is not encrypted.
The language pack comes from the project page on GitHub. GitHub learns the device’s internet address (IP address) and the time. No recipes are sent.
Text recognition and translation run entirely on the device, without internet. Android’s automatic cloud backup is turned off.
